title: Manga translation modes have materially different outbound data boundaries
symptom: The project's documented local mode runs in-browser, self-hosted API mode sends OCR text to the chosen endpoint, while Gemini mode sends entire page images to a cloud provider.
user_impact: A user seeking privacy may reveal more image context than intended when choosing a cloud image-to-translation mode.

steps: Choose Local or a verified local self-hosted API endpoint for sensitive or licensed source images; distinguish a remote 'compatible' URL from a local server.

remaining_question: Can users tell the difference in the UI without reading the full README and are there unexpected outbound requests?
verification_plan: Inspect the model switch UI and capture outbound HTTP calls for each mode; no private manga pages in public test artifacts.
